title: The Novel Written in Letters
short_teaser: Epistolary stories use letters, journals, or messages to reveal character through partial viewpoints.
story: Epistolary stories use letters, journals, or messages to reveal character through partial viewpoints. A chosen form can create intimacy and mystery at the same time. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A chosen form can create intimacy and mystery at the same time. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning.
spark_application: Make a rough version of one idea before judging it. Explore for ten minutes. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
